title: Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation Meets SAM3
mechanism: Frozen SAM3 promptable concept segmentation with support and query placed side by side on one canvas and the support mask as exemplar; no training.
evidence: R: SOTA on PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i training-free; negative prompts often cause prediction collapse.
adaptation: Two 512 px cells on SAM3's 1008 px canvas (near native size); positive exemplars only; inactive and structural classes as main target; needs the user's OK for gated SAM3 weights.
min_experiment: In G0 after weights OK: FSS-SAM3 canvas vs house PF ensemble on val54+F51+H36, inactive IoU and crack relF1@2; kill if below house PF on both and below GFDS SAM2 mode.
prior_overlap: none; SAM3 never run here (D14 proposes a zero-shot text-prompt probe, different mechanism).
